html:
SMTO-OBS-0006 — SMTO couldn't load the full output for this step

GUID: 6f2f959a-11d9-5bb0-a228-fdec7613e011
Slug: retained-output-unavailable
Domain: OBS · Subsystem: retained

What happened

  • The complete output for this step couldn't be shown or copied here. Part of it may no longer be saved, or the page asked for it in a way SMTO doesn't support.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Close the output section and open it again. If it still fails, reload the page and open the step again. The page may be pointing at activity that changed after it loaded; reopening asks for the current version.
  2. For a Model's text, select Download full capture in Model output instead of Copy output. The download saves whatever SMTO still has, while a copy stops with this error if any part is missing.
  3. If the message says the complete section is no longer available, use the shorter preview on screen, or check the file or system the step worked on. SMTO kept only a shortened copy of that part, and running the step again could repeat its actions.

What success looks like

  • The output opens, or the copy or download finishes without an error.

If it still fails

  • If the same output fails every time, select Copy error details and send them, with the conversation's name, to the person who manages SMTO. Don't run the step again to get its output back.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • An activity, tool-output or model-output retrieval endpoint could not return complete retained content: the event, section or command is no longer in the trace, only a truncated preview of the section was retained, the requested output channel is unsupported, or retained model output disappeared during a clipboard export.

What this means

  • Output/activity lookup lacks retained complete content, a copy channel is unsupported, or browser pagination/detail retrieval fails its expected contract. Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.

Why this can happen

  • Output/activity lookup lacks retained complete content, a copy channel is unsupported, or browser pagination/detail retrieval fails its expected contract.

How to diagnose it

  • Distinguish missing/truncated retained bytes from invalid copy options or a non-advancing page cursor; inspect the authoritative source separately.

How to fix it

  • Refresh the activity and request a current request_id, event_id, invocation_id or section_id; use GET /api/agent/trace/<request_id>/models/<call_id>/download (channel all, reasoning, answer or tool) for full captures. Preserve the remaining receipts and report a repeatable failure on a current, supported reference as a retrieval defect with its Error ID.
  • Refresh and use a supported current output/activity reference; preserve remaining receipts and report a repeatable retrieval-contract defect.

Retry and execution caution

  • Confirm current state and correct the reported condition before requesting another attempt. Do not replay work with an unknown outcome.

How to verify the fix

  • Supported current references retrieve the available complete content, with any missing evidence disclosed.

What not to do

  • Do not delete retained evidence or retry an operation whose effect is unknown.

Technical notes

  • Observation is read-only and scoped to retained evidence. Missing, ambiguous or incomplete presentation cannot prove that external work failed or never happened; no diagnostic reconstructs or replays it.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
